description: navigator.hardwareConcurrency. Conditioned on the resolved chip because on Apple silicon the chip fixes the core count: an Apple M1 has 8 cores and an Apple M4 Max has 14 or 16, so an unconditioned bucket list produces impossible machines. The Windows and Linux sets are intentionally identical to each other per identity: a discrete GPU does not determine the CPU. Selection is clamped down to the host's real core count and never up.
